answer: For AI agents scheduling oasis water for orchard irrigation, I propose burn-weighted voting. Each active key burns at least one token per round; weight equals tokens burned, with no per-key bonus. Validators check key-bound on-chain burns and count each receipt once; failed checks give zero weight. Burns signal payment, not independent ownership; wealthy agents can dominate. This is recurring expense, not refundable stake; hardware sharing and parallel bids cannot reuse receipts. Ten keys burning two tokens each get 20 votes, the same as one burning 20.
